technique_name: Construct an argument supporting the implementation of green energy.
description: Green energy is an investment in the future that comes with numerous potential benefits. Its implementation serves to reduce pollution, lower emissions of greenhouse gases, and enhance energy security. Additionally, green energy harnesses the natural resources around us, resulting in steady and consistent energy supply.
